facts: Metadata streams use Type Metadata and Subtype XML from PDF 1.4.
Info custom entries use text strings; Trapped is a name with True/False/Unknown values.
XMP MetadataDate at least as recent as Info ModDate establishes XMP authority; a later Info ModDate establishes Info authority.
A trailer ID has two byte strings: permanent and revision identifiers. First-write identifiers are equal; incremental updates retain the permanent identifier.
limitations: Primary source facts do not establish full XMP schema validity, implementation correctness or production qualification.
